title: realpath -J record
description: One name resolved by `realpath -J`. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

resolved.description: The canonical name realpath prints for it (relative with --relative-to).

resolved_bytes.description: The bytes of `resolved`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`resolved` then holds the lossy form).
